note: Recast from the original description of Lash (1952), in English; the alate description is complete and accompanied by a measurement table, and the soldier is treated only qualitatively (it is accepted as a separate morphotype, not as material from the same colony). Table 3 of the original (soldier measurements) is a landscape table in that PDF and is unreadable after extraction because the lines are displaced, so no soldier values are entered.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body colour light reddish brown to dark reddish brown. Compound eyes rather small, surrounded by a proportionally rather wide ring of sclerite; the ocellus is less than its own diameter from the compound eye. Postclypeus dark and distinctly projecting, wedge-shaped in lateral view, its tip approaching a right angle. Antenna 17 segments (16 plus the scape). Head bristles slightly sparser than in other species of the genus. Tibiae dark, becoming pale towards the tip, the midpoint of the colour change about halfway along the tibia; tarsi pigmented, opaque.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate differs from the other species of the genus in 3 characters: the projecting postclypeus, the graduated tibial colour and the proportionally wide ring of sclerite around the compound eye. The postclypeus is not projecting in the yellow-thorax and black-thorax Reticulitermes species and in the house termite group, and is projecting only in R. lucifugus var. santonensis, and there to a lesser degree than in this species; the periocular sclerite is narrow in all the other species.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: No stable morphological difference was found between the soldier of this species and that of the European R. lucifugus; the body is throughout distinctly smaller and can be told apart with the naked eye, and there are slight differences in the measurements, but the author considered none of them, apart from body size, sufficient for specific separation. Because the soldier specimens did not come from the same colony as the alates, the author assigned them to this species as a morphotype.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate measurements (mm, n=10): body length without wings 4.22—5.09, mean 4.33; head length (to the lateral projection) 0.84—0.94, mean 0.89; head width 0.88—0.98, mean 0.93; greatest diameter of the compound eye 0.17—0.21, mean 0.20; distance from the ocellus to the compound eye 0.02—0.07, mean 0.03; pronotum width 0.74—0.80, mean 0.76; pronotum length 0.41—0.50, mean 0.45; clypeus length 0.21—0.26, mean 0.24; postclypeus length 0.17—0.20, mean 0.19; postclypeus width 0.46—0.53, mean 0.49; antenna 17 segments. Type locality Jerusalem (Palestine); the alates were collected on 1943-5-16 and the soldiers, workers and nymphs on 1947-1-30; the holotype and the morphotype are in the Emerson Collection of the American Museum of Natural History.
